label: R5 · Opponent's declare blockers
rationale: Blockers are declared (none; your creatures can't block fliers) and this is the last priority before combat damage. Helicarrier Strike ({W}, 2 damage to an attacking creature) kills any of the three attackers now, ideally Giant-Sized Flying Ant (3/2). Passing takes 6 at 13 life and wastes the window the card needs.
